2607.28778.title: Stratified Negation in RDF Rules: A Correct Approach (Extended Version)
2607.28778.paper_summary: Combining RDF rule languages, such as N3 or SHACL Rules, with default negation is challenging. Existing methods to stratify negation often fail for RDF rules, since individual triples do not carry enough information to meaningfully restrict potential dependencies. Blank nodes in rule heads further complicate the matter, since the order of rule applications may determine whether new values are created, which in turn can change the applicability of rules with negation. To solve these open problems, we propose chain stratification as a robust new condition that guarantees a well-behaved semantics for RDF rules with negation, and existential rules in general. Our condition combines an elaborate analysis of potential multistep derivations with a mechanism for using integrity constraints to discard impossible cases. Applying rules in any order that respects chain stratification is guaranteed to derive an RDF graph that is unique, lean, and justified under the usual negation-as-failure semantics. To show the practicality, we also provide a prototype implementation.
2607.28778.paper_summary_zh: 結合 RDF 規則語言，如 N3 或 SHACL 規則，與默認否定是具有挑戰性的。現有的分層否定方法通常對 RDF 規則失效，因為單個三元組並不攜帶足夠的信息來有意義地限制潛在的依賴關係。規則頭中的空白節點進一步複雜化了問題，因為規則應用的順序可能決定是否創建新值，這反過來又可以改變帶有否定的規則的適用性。為了解決這些未解決的問題，我們提出了鏈式分層作為一種穩健的新條件，保證帶有否定的 RDF 規則以及一般存在規則的良好語義。我們的條件結合了對潛在多步推導的詳細分析，以及利用完整性約束來排除不可能情況的機制。以任何尊重鏈式分層的順序應用規則，保證推導出一個唯一、精簡且在通常的否定作為失敗語義下得到證明的 RDF 圖。為了展示實用性，我們還提供了一個原型實現。
